title: Wang case replay readiness is not expert-method fidelity
claim: The Wang Tingzhi corpus contains 24 source cases and 24 target-palace evidence materializations, with retrieval and action selection marked ready for all 24 folds; the earlier method-policy readiness v0.2 reports 0/24 full expert replay readiness. Later accepted source-input reconstruction evaluates 37 bounded candidate inputs and finds 11 unique target-anchor matches, 6 multiple matches, 5 no matches, 2 source-incomplete cases and 0 engine-unsupported candidates. Only the 11 unique matches are eligible for later full-chart materialization; full-chart materialization and expert replay are still not complete.
maturity_note: The earlier readiness v0.2 is a historical readiness snapshot. Product #545 / PR #554 later added a source-bounded reconstruction readiness layer, but current Product state names WANG_FULL_CHART_MATERIALIZATION_V0_1B as next work. The 11 unique anchor matches are eligible for later materialization, not full-chart equivalence or expert replay.
wording_ceiling: Say '24-case source corpus with partial readiness; 11 cases are eligible for later full-chart materialization under a target-palace anchor gate, while 13 remain withheld and full expert replay is not ready'; do not claim completed full charts, method fidelity, or predictive validity.

evidence_refs.label: Current Product lane state cache after Product #545
evidence_refs.note: Names WANG_FULL_CHART_MATERIALIZATION_V0_1B as next work; it does not claim the 11 eligible charts are already materialized.

limitations: Only source-visible target-palace major-star facts are materialized in the blind evidence layer.
Source reconstruction compares target-palace identity and the fourteen-major-star anchor (or explicitly borrowed opposite-palace anchor); it does not establish full-source-chart equivalence.
11 unique target-anchor matches are eligible for later full-chart materialization, but that later materialization remains a separate Product work unit.
The six multiple matches, five no-anchor matches and two source-incomplete cases remain withheld.
Subject identity, expert prose, conclusions, outcomes and external biography must remain unavailable to the blind evaluator.
Full expert replay requires full-chart materialization and target-scope method binding.
